notes.title: Update Demo Ver. 2.0.1
notes.notes:
Legacy of Ashes – Update 2.0.1 is live!

Chapter 1 has been optimized, delivering 60 FPS on High Settings (with recommended hardware). 

resized the HUD for a better fit.

notes.title: Legacy of Ashes – Demo 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the release of Demo 2.0 for Legacy of Ashes!
This version represents a major leap forward compared to the first demo, bringing the experience closer to the full game.
🔹 Key Changes and Improvements:[olist]
Chapter 1 of the full game is now available to play.

Improved gameplay mechanics for both combat and stealth, with deeper interaction with items and the environment.

Third-person view has been established as the main perspective for the game.

Character redesign to better fit the game’s atmosphere.

Expanded menu options, including:

Key binding for keyboard, mouse, and controller.

Gameplay settings.

Graphics settings.

Display settings.

Audio settings.

New Save & Load system to continue your progress.

Added support for 11 languages:

English

Arabic

French

Italian

German

Spanish

Japanese

Korean

Brazilian Portuguese

Russian

Simplified Chinese
[/olist][hr][/hr]
This demo is only the beginning… the island still hides many secrets.


We look forward to hearing your feedback and experiences!

notes.title: 🚨 Demo Version 2 Coming Soon – The Beginning of Chapter 1!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’re excited to announce that Demo Version 2 is on the way – and this time, it’s not just a preview... it’s the official beginning of Chapter 1 from the full game.

This update brings massive changes in gameplay, visuals, and storytelling.

🔥 What’s New in Demo Version 2:
All-new mechanics: smoother, more immersive controls

First-person camera removed – third-person experience only

Aura97 revealed: a completely redesigned look for the main character

Epic narrative updates: get deeper into the mystery of Nova Corp

Dr. Helena Vale joins the mission – a key main character who guides you and slowly reveals layers of the truth behind Nova Corp

More horror, more tension, and more secrets to uncover...

🕒 Last Chance to Experience Aura96
Before Demo Version 2 launches, this is your final chance to experience the original Demo Version 1 and meet Aura96 – a character design that will be removed forever once the new demo goes live.

If you’ve played the first demo, this is your chance to say goodbye.
If you haven’t – now is the time.

Demo Version 2 marks a new era for the game. Everything is changing...
We can’t wait for you to see what’s coming.

– Nova Corp
